label: A church rising with a backbone like a crowbar
description: A glorious church rising with a backbone like a crowbar, set against the idea that the two parties will simply become friends and get along. He adds that the church does not represent a country and that he does not see it as American, Asian or anything else.
aliases: a backbone like a crowbar
a glorious church is going to rise up
the church doesn't represent a country

label: The denominational walls come down and they function as one body
description: God taking down denominational barriers between Baptists, Methodists, Catholics and Episcopalians, with the statement that they will function as a body, and that the move did not involve a government.
aliases: God's taken down denominational barriers between Baptists, Methodists
You will function as a body

label: A dark plan devised between Democrats and Canada
description: Democrats seen talking with Canada and devising a plan, with something very dark about a meeting that he says had not yet taken place when he saw it.
aliases: Democrats were talking to Canada and they were devising a plan
the meeting hadn't taken place

label: Lineages of people presented to the president
description: Things being presented to the president that he marks as symbolic, with the French president seen and lineages of people, which he says he does not understand and which dried his mouth. Given as the president travels to China.
aliases: I saw lineages of people. I thought what is that?
I saw things being presented to Trump
my mouth dried

label: Ukraine and Russia stop before Iran does
description: Asked which conflict stops first, he says he heard by the spirit that Ukraine and Russia will stop first rather than Iran.
aliases: Which one will stop first?
Ukraine and Russia has will stop first. Not Iran

label: He pushes away the golden statue and the golden calf
description: A refusal to look at a golden statue, which he calls bad, and a statement that he pushes anything resembling false idols and golden calf material far away from himself.
aliases: I'm not looking at the golden statue
anything that looks like false idols and golden calf stuff

label: Keep an archive of the big words so they are not buried
description: An instruction to keep an archive of the significant words so they do not get buried inside two and three hour broadcasts and lost.
aliases: keep an archives of some things of the big words
so that they don't get buried

label: Three named commentators turn in different directions
description: Alex Jones seen becoming a John the Baptist figure, Tucker Carlson's heart turning from grey to black so that he stands against, and Candace Owens going down the rabbit hole and starting to act erratically. Given as something he had said in the days ahead and now claims is happening.
aliases: I saw him being a John the Baptist
Tucker Carlson's heart will turn from gray to black
Candace Owens will go down the rabbit hole

label: Little teeth nipping up from the ground in California
description: Coming from Berlin to something tied to the church, a shaking in California again, with what look like little teeth nipping up from the ground like plants.
aliases: these little teeth that are nipping from the ground
it looks like plants

label: Separate yourself and you will see the great glory
description: A word of rebuke that they say they want the revival and the glory but have too much of the world in them, with an instruction to separate themselves to see the great glory, and a remnant said to have already done so.
aliases: you have so much of the world in you
Separate yourself unto me and you will see the great glory

label: A great breakthrough concerning the strait, with China involved
description: A hedge prayed around the decisions being made over Iran and the strait, with a great breakthrough coming concerning it and China involved, after which he says it will be Cuba's turn.
aliases: There's going to be a great breakthrough concerning the strait
China is going to be involved in this
then it will be Cuba's turn
